members.name: Member 1
members.role: Project lead: problem definition and data engineering
contributions: Defined the miner-decision problem, constraints and alternative solutions
Built acquisition of 6,500+ daily block dumps, pool definitions, solo lists, network charts and electricity prices with SHA-256 provenance
Cleaned and labelled 975k blocks, wrote the data dictionary, quality checks and label audit

members.name: Member 2
contributions: Designed fingerprint features (version/nonce bit decomposition, timing, day-relative policy) and the leakage exclusions
Ran feature selection (variance, mutual information vs noise probes, Spearman redundancy, group ablation)
Tuned the decision tree, KNN and SVM with month-grouped CV and nested CV; froze the model choice

members.name: Member 3
contributions: Evaluated the frozen models on the sealed 2025-26 test period (macro-F1, confusion, ROC/PR, day-block bootstrap, drift)
Discovered mining eras with K-means, four hierarchical linkages and DBSCAN, and pool families by dendrogram
Implemented Apriori from scratch with brute-force verification, rule confirmation and the solo contrast

members.name: Member 4
members.role: Decision support, Future Lab and web dashboard
contributions: Built the miner advisor (pool vs solo vs do not mine across 27 economies) and the Unknown-block attribution
Built the Future Lab: block-bootstrap hash-rate scenarios, 2028 halving timing and the historical backtest
Built and deployed the interactive dashboard (React, TypeScript, ECharts) and prepared the live demo

members.name: Member 5
members.role: Verification, ethics, AI-agent governance and reporting
contributions: Wrote the independent verification checks and the test suite
Led the ethics review and the AI-agent use and verification log; collected every member's trajectory
Edited the report and slides, and coordinated rehearsals
